title: Maximum Product Subarray (DP)
statement:
Given an integer array `nums`, find a subarray that has the largest product, and return the product.
Use a DP approach tracking both the minimum and maximum product ending at each index to handle negative numbers.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
constraints:
1 <= nums.length <= 2 * 10^4
-10 <= nums[i] <= 10
The product of any subarray of nums is guaranteed to fit in a 32-bit integer.

examples.explanation: Cannot get product > 0, but 0 from single element 0.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
# dp_max[i] and dp_min[i] — track both extremes due to negatives
